regions.merged_text: Mrs. Wm. Walker - 59 - came to monastery June 3, her husband a convert, had wandered away and fallen from religion altogether. That was ten years ago and folks had received no word from him during all that time. He had changed his name. June 3rd last which was Thursday his wife came and had the Poor Souls Enrolled in the S. Mass Assoc'n for that intention. ... The following Monday June 7th she received a telephone message about her husband who had died May 25 seven yrs. ago. This message came to his wife while his own mother ... still methodist ... was present. Next day the messenger came and told everything .. . (Goss messenger) Mr. Walker (Parker) had turned back to Church and was plan- ing to get back to Detroit & family when + suddenly-heart .. .. Remorse of Conscious forced messenger to give secret. . .
